text:
Hana: APAC cloud marketplace PO from 'SkyScale APAC Pte Ltd' is stuck. Portal shows 'commitment_account_mismatch' and auto-rejects. Partner swears they're using the correct commitment account.

Diego: Which commitment id did they provide?

Hana: They provided 'C-AP-7788' but ledger expects 'CAP-7788'. Small formatting change but portal is strict.

Mei: Finance: we link commitments by canonical id. We can accept if partner provides proof of entitlement or if we create a mapping. Which is faster?

Connor: Ops: we can create a transient commitment alias for partner_id ss-332 so we don't delay launch. Need approval from finance and a logged audit entry.

finance_bot: commitments-service: reject - COMMITMENT_NOT_FOUND (payload id: C-AP-7788)

Mei: Approve transient alias if partner provides entitlement screenshot from their MSP console AND we require reconciliation within 3 business days.

Diego: Legal: anything about creating alias like this? Is there risk with billing alignment?

legal_bot: policy-check: allowed_with_condition - require signed statement of authorization and record retention 7 years.

Connor: I'll provision alias mapping ss-332 -> CAP-7788 with flag 'transient: true' and expire in 72h. Patch: POST /admin/commitment_alias {"partner_id":"ss-332","alias":"C-AP-7788","canonical":"CAP-7788","ttl":259200} (audit: conn-1737779000)

Hana: Partner submitted MSP entitlement screenshot and a signed authorization PDF to marketplace@redwood.com.

Mei: Received docs. Finance will ingest under transient alias and flag for reconciliation. Please ensure invoice references canonical CAP-7788.

Connor: Alias created and feature-flagged. marketplace-bot: alias_created (actor: connor, time: 1737779005).

finance_bot: ingest-service: success - PO matched to commitment CAP-7788. Invoice scheduled. ticket: INV-AP-332.

Diego: Note action items: (1) add fuzzy matching for commitment prefixes in portal, (2) UX to upload entitlement proof during submission.

Mei: I'll put both in backlog and prioritize fuzzy-matching for APAC commitments. Opening ticket MKT-4240.

Hana: Launch unblocked. Thanks everyone. Closing escalation. :partyparrot:
